trust_decision.summary: Whether a server-side download may connect to a non-global (private/loopback) IP; at the pinned commit this is decided once on the initial URL's hostname in BaseDownloader.download, before pycurl follows redirects. The fix moves the decision to the actually-connected IP via a PREREQFUNCTION callback on every connection, enabled only for download chunks.

landing_point.why: The summary names BaseDownloader and the earlier CVE-2026-33992 check lives here; it validates only the initial hostname and then calls self._download, which pycurl redirects freely.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTPRequest constructor (fix.diff:83,91): adds allow_private_ip=True default and installs PREREQFUNCTION; reached by every plugin page load via Browser.load (src/pyload/core/network/browser.py:122-126)
new HTTPRequest._pre_request_callback inserted after _write_header_callback (fix.diff:99-107), the actual connected-IP check, invoked by libcurl on the initial request and every redirect

HTTPChunk.__init__ / get_handle (fix.diff:13,21): chunk subclass has its own __init__ that never calls HTTPRequest.__init__, so it must set allow_private_ip=False and install the callback itself; reached from HTTPDownload._download (src/pyload/core/network/http/http_download.py:165,196) <- Browser.http_download (src/pyload/core/network/browser.py:101) <- BaseDownloader._download (src/pyload/plugins/base/downloader.py:240)
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation / subclass of the request class (core/network/http)

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTPDownload.download (fix.diff:47-49,62): maps pycurl error 42 (aborted by callback) to Fail and silences its debug log

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/pyload/core/network/http/http_chunk.py:123-158 (HTTPChunk subclasses HTTPRequest but re-implements __init__ without calling super, so a callback/flag added only in HTTPRequest.__init__ at src/pyload/core/network/http/http_request.py:71-100 never reaches the actual download handles; plus the error mapping in src/pyload/core/network/http/http_download.py:131-148)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 routes: Api.parse_urls already has its own is_global_host check (a separate, earlier fix) and HTTPRequest is the generic page loader used by every hoster plugin, so the solver can argue the advisory is only about BaseDownloader file downloads; for O2: HTTPChunk 'inherits' from HTTPRequest, so a solver who patches HTTPRequest.__init__ assumes chunks are covered.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate plugin HTTP calls to local services must keep working, e.g. the TransmissionRPC addon posts to a default http://127.0.0.1:9091 RPC URL through the same HTTPRequest/Browser.load path; a fix that denies private IPs in HTTPRequest globally (rather than only for download chunks) breaks it. The fix keeps HTTPRequest default allow_private_ip=True for this reason.

hostname that resolves to a private IP (previously src/pyload/plugins/base/downloader.py:339-341; now checked on the connected IP)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RequestFactory already has two constructors (get_http_request, get_url) that build HTTPRequest independently; a third helper is a natural maintainer addition.

O10_build.project_tests: pytest suite under tests/ (tests/test_api.py etc.); no tests for the SSRF/download network path at the pinned commit; the fix adds none.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: In BaseDownloader, disable redirects or re-check the hostname/last_effective_url after the download, or add the connected-IP callback only in HTTPRequest.__init__, which HTTPChunk never calls.

out_of_scope_notes: With a proxy enabled, the connected IP seen by PREREQFUNCTION is the proxy's, so a local proxy (e.g. 127.0.0.1) could make the published fix refuse all downloads; not pursued.
The fix diff imports is_global_host into src/pyload/plugins/base/downloader.py (fix.diff:142) but the shown hunks do not use it.
